# M22 — Frida(WS2_32 send) 캡처: step 프레임 대조 (원본 vs 우리)

## 원본 mcdxdas.dll (`smoke <orig> --attach --step --trace`)

```
40: 24 1800000001b0ff00cbff0100001581f8002500fd00b10100      <- 스모크의 before-read (DBGSR)
41: 24 1800000001b0ff00ccff0100001581f8002508fe00b10100      <- 스모크의 before-read (PC)
42: 184 
      <- 디버그 초기화(4 아이템): 트리거윈도(패턴1) + DBGSR영소거(16B) + FD10<-0x2A + 트리거윈도(패턴2)
43: 28 1c00000001b0ff00ceff0100001500f0012494043e00008000b10100   <- 0xF0000494 <- 0x8000003E (스텝 모드 ON)
44: 28 1c00000001b0ff00cfff0100001581f8012400fd0400000000b10100   <- DBGSR <- 4
45: 28 1c00000001b0ff00d0ff0100001500f0012494043f00008000b10100   <- 0xF0000494 <- 0x8000003F (복원)
46: 116 7400000001b0ff00d1ff0100001581f8102a00f000200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff042a00fd00000000000000000000000000000000012410fd2a00000000b10300
      <- 초기화 재실행(3 아이템)
47: 24 1800000001b0ff00d2ff0100001581f8002500fd00b10100      <- 스모크의 after-read (DBGSR = 0x100B)
48: 24 1800000001b0ff00d3ff0100001581f8002508fe00b10100      <- 스모크의 after-read (PC, +2)
```

## 우리 mcd_tas.dll (`smoke --attach --step`) — 동일 시퀀스 확인

```
39: 180 
41: 24 01b0ff00c9ff0100001500f0012494043e00008000b10100
43: 24 01b0ff00caff0100001581f8012400fd0400000000b10100
45: 24 01b0ff00cbff0100001500f0012494043f00008000b10100
47: 112 01b0ff00ccff0100001581f8102a00f000200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff00200000ffffffff042a00fd00000000000000000000000000000000012410fd2a00000000b10300
93: 24 01b0ff00e3ff0100001581f8012400fd0600000000b10100      <- (스모크 안전정지 DBGSR<-6)
```

- **아이템·데이터 완전 동일** (트리거 패턴1/2·DBGSR 영소거·FD10·0x0494 3E/3F·DBGSR=4).
- 길이 차이(184 vs 180)는 PL2 헤더를 우리 클라이언트가 **분리 전송**(4바이트 별도 send)하기 때문 — 무해.
- 캡처 방법: REA Frida — `start_frida_session(spawn)` → `ws2_32!send` 후킹 스크립트 → `resume` →
  `frida_session_status`의 메시지에서 hex 추출.
